description: Lock in exactly one single-word guess for the user's newest photo, or for the hint they just spent, based on all of today's photos together. First describe the photo to the user in one sentence (after a hint, say what it changes). One guess per new photo or hint: otherwise the next guess waits for the next photo. Writing that's already in the world is fine, but the guess can't be a word written in the photo. When writing was made for the game, a screen stands in for the real thing, the user types a hint, or your guess is written in the photo, use call_foul instead. Returns how close the guess is: cold, warm, hot, burning, or correct. In Get Out & Go, pass star: which of the five words the photo is for. Use every photo of that word so far. In a friends challenge, pass its challenge code.

challenge.description: A friends challenge code, like "K7QFX", when this call is for that challenge instead of the daily word.

guess.description: One word. Up to three words only for a fixed phrase.

mode.description: Which star game this photo is for, when the user has both Get Out & Go and a course in play: "go" or "courses". Leave it out to use the one they played last.

player.description: The player code from start_round, e.g. "brave-otter-4821". The same code in every chat keeps the streak going.

read.description: One sentence on what you see in the photo (or what the hint changed), kept for the recap.

star.description: Get Out & Go only: which of the five words this is for, 1 to 5 stars. The user says it, or the card sends "Next photo's for the ★★★ word."

name: submit_guess
title: Submit a Show & Tell guess
